profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at W.R Berkley
profile.summary:
[SCEA, SCWCD, SCBCD, SCJP] 
Sr. Software Engineer with 9 years of experience in architecture, design and development of enterprise applications. Wide knowledge in client-side and server-side implementations using open source technologies.

Specialties: JEE, Java, Web-services, EJB, XML, HTML, ExtJS, JQuery, Ajax, Spring, Hibernate, Oracle, MySql, Design Patterns.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
[Web Team]:
Defining and designing architecture based on most current technologies such as Spring 3.x, Hibernate, Java 7, JQuery, and Bootstrap. 
Creating architecture artifacts with UML diagrams such as Global Diagrams, Class Diagrams, 
Component Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, and Deployment Diagrams. 
Configured all Spring and Hibernate contexts based on XML files and annotations.
Configured authentication mechanism based on LDAP and JAAS using JBoss 7. 
Developed a component to connect to ADOBE Livecycle. This 3er party system is in charge of 
encrypting documents and provides the rights to have access to them. This communication is accomplished via JAX-RPC Web Services. 
Developed a component to connect and process information based on a guided navigation engine called Oracle Endeca. Connection performed via a custom API using HTTP.
Implemented a component to send notification emails based on spring API. 
Implemented a File System component based on Java 7 and a Networked Attached Storage (NAS). 
Implemented different CRON components based on Spring container (XML and annotations). 
Implemented Oracle functions and stored procedures to optimized database processing.

[Interfaces Team]:
Implemented different top-down web services for different applications using apache-axis and java.
Created multiple data access classes to manipulate Oracle tables using Hibernate.
Used Design patterns to implement back-end services such as Factories, templates, strategies, 
singletons.
Created SQL queries and store procedures using PL/SQL.
Integrated Spring MVC in existing web applications.
Added AJAX functionality to existing Web applications using JQuery.
Created architecture artifacts such as high level design documents and UML diagrams.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
As a Sr. developer I was responsible for:
Re-design and development of an existing presentation layer using JQuery.
Implementation of asynchronous components in the front end using AJAX and JSON.
Implementation of MVC components based on JEE specification.
Designing and implementing components in the business and back-end tiers using  EJBs and Data
Access Objects.
Wrote PL/SQL store procedures and queries to store and retrieve data to/from  Oracle 11g database.
Creating architecture artifacts such as high level design documents, architecture diagrams, etc.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
As a technical architect did analysis and evaluation of most recent technologies, which could be potentially incorporated as part of new solutions and standards for new enterprise systems.
Contributed on the definition of the new architectures for web and portal applications.
Ensuring the use of best practices considering business requirements, technologies and non-functional requirements.
Working together with the design teams to prevent and detect possible problems during the design and implementation phases.
Working together with the functional architecture team to analyze and determine whether business requirements were doable to be accomplished by a software implementation. 
Ensuring non functional requirements such as security, scalability, high availability, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
[December 2008 - Present]  
Project: Portal Application
•Responsible to define development standards used in the whole life of the project.
•Designed and implemented horizontal and vertical components applying different design patterns. These components are being used right away by different modules into iCRM application and by others portal applications used in Intercall. (Security Component, Cache Component, Sales Force users Component, Permission Component, Catalog Component, etc).
•Used of dynamic programming such as reflection, generics, solutions by names convention, dependency injection, etc.
•The main development environment was Bea workshop: Java page flow and NETUI, portlets, annotations, controllers, ejbs, custom controls, jdbc controls, service controls, ejb controls, type’s jars, etc.
•Deployments Weblogic 10.1

TOOLS:  Bea Portal 10.1, Enterprise Service Bus, JEE, Java Page Flow, Netui, JSP 2.1, JSTL 1.2, Javascript, ExtJS, Ajax, Java 5, Java 6, UML, XML technologies,  Apache tools, log4j, Ant, spring 2.0, JNDI, Hibernate, Oracle 10g, Apache JCS, GOF and J2EE design patterns, Soap-UI, Subversion, Enterprise Architect, starUML, Quality Center, SCRUM.   


[February 2008 – November 2008]
Project: Enterprise Application

TOOLS USED:  Linux RedHat 7.x, Korn Shell, C Shell, Informix, C, C++, Java 1.4, subversion, eclipse 2.x.


[November 2006 – February 2008]
Projects: Web Application

TOOLS USED:  Java 1.4, Java 5, JSP 2.x, JSTL 1.x, JavaScript, DWR AJAX, Apache tools, UML, J2EE standards, GOF and J2EE patterns,  Axis, starUML, Tomcat 5, Linux RedHat 7.x, perforce as version control system.


[July 2006 – November 2006]
Project: Document Process System

TOOLS USED: Java 1.4, J2EE standards, UML, GOF and J2EE design patterns, Linux RedHat, JMS, EJBs, Bea application server, XSLT, XML-FO,  XML-Spy.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
•Main role was such as software designer. I created different software artifacts which were distributed for our national (Mexico) and international (Colombia) offices. These artifacts implied the design of UML diagrams, High Level Design Documents, Test use cases, etc.
•	Developed some generic components applying design patterns, J2EE and Java 1.4 to be distributed through our two offices. Basically the architecture proposed to cover all the requirements was: Delegate and façade as entry point, SOA concepts to call services, and for persistence tier the Entity pattern along with Expresso framework (DBObjects) were used.
•Collaborated in the deployment processes using Web-sphere application server 6.
•Responsible to coordinate the maintenance team of Safre 3.0. The main responsibility was to ensure quality solutions following the terms and standards proposed by the architecture team.
	
TOOLS:  Expresso, Java 1.4, J2EE standards, Spring, UML, GOF and J2EE design patterns, Reverse Engineering, JMS, EJBs, Web services, Workflow, Rational Application Architect, Websphere Application Server 6, XML technologies, subversion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
J2EE application
	
•Used expresso framework for the presentation tier. Developed Controllers, DBObjects, Outputs, Inputs, JDBC classes.
•Implemented different JSP pages together with Java Script functionality and the use of dynAPI.
•Used inversion of control concept through the spring core framework to create back-end services classes.
•I was in charge of implementing different client and business java classes for all tiers of this application.
•Created reports using XML technology.
•Created a Reports component using jasper reports API.
•Implemented classes dedicated to parse documents using XML technology.
•Implemented Stateless, Timers and Message Driven Beans.
•Collaborated in the deployment processes, and the configuration of Websphere application server 5.1.

TOOLS:  Expresso, Java 1.4, J2EE standards, JSP 1.x, JavaScript, dynAPI, UML, Spring, J2EE design patterns, MQ, JMS, EJBs, Web services, Workflow, Websphere Application Server 5.1, XML-FO, XSLT, XPath, Xerces, Digester, XML-spy, RUP methodology, MS SQL Server, subversion.
